barRaise.topFinding: The exposure that has led this report for seventeen runs is on two public surfaces, not one, and the fix on file only closed the smaller of them. gh repo view reports isPrivate: false, so raw.githubusercontent.com serves .work-queue.json at 1,070,727 bytes alongside the identical Pages copy, and usage-log/Skylight.jsonl answers 200 there too, on a path Pages at least robots-disallows. The 2026-07-26 remedy was to delete the two backup-bearing files in deploy-pages.yml before upload-pages-artifact; that removes one of two copies while the fix log reads as closed. This morning canonical audit caught it and rewrote the queue item in place, so the corrected order is already live: back the queue up outside this public repo, untrack both files, then re-fetch on Pages AND raw and confirm 404 on both. Separately the payload grew 826 KB to 1,071 KB in one day and the served queue now names Skylight 317 times against 220 yesterday, so the thing being decided is getting more expensive to leave undecided.
